segments.description: Quick montage showing a grocery cart filled with budget items and shots of cooked budget meals.
Host directly talks to the camera in her kitchen, explaining the theme of five different $5 budget family dinners.
A vlog-style sequence inside Walmart showing the selection and purchase of various cheap ingredients while narration continues.

hook.opening_visual: Fast-paced montage of a shopping cart with groceries and shots of warm budget casseroles.
hook.opening_line: An issue that we are all faced with right now is that we keep hoping grocery prices are going to come down...
hook.notes: Text overlay '$5 Budget Dinners!' over dynamic shots instantly sets the core value proposition of the video.

cta_moments.text: Make sure you're subscribed down below the video so you don't miss the next one like this.
